data: CYBY24: thread labels 3/4 positive, 1/2 negative; prior public source used for exploration
protocol: same raw thread prefix fits all four tokenizers and Phocinae question, 256 total tokens per model; grouped by exact message and tweet ID; 2 epochs, final two layers and head for MobileBERT/ModernBERT/Phocinae; pre-fine-tuned RoBERTa not retrained
threshold_policy: on calibration, maximum precision among score thresholds achieving recall >=0.8; score is not a calibrated probability
limitations: Exploratory previously inspected same-source test, not independent or Instagram; thread labels weak for message-level inference; class prevalence source-specific; cross-author and near-duplicate leakage possible; same raw prefixes but tokenization and model heads differ; pretraining and source overlap unknown; no Android measurements.
